chapter_title_en: The Weight of a Sect’s Legacy
chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Gets the Black-White College’s Complete Arsenal — and a Zhuanshui Invitation
chapter_meta_description: Wufeng Immortal delivers every key divine ability and secret art to Ji Ning. A political invitation from the Zhuanshui clan arrives. Floating Cloud Immortal panics as his deadline nears.
og_title: Ji Ning Receives a Mountain of Divine Abilities — The Black-White College’s Final Push
og_description: In this chapter, Ji Ning memorizes a dozen top-tier divine abilities from the Black-White College. His master has gone wandering, his assassin is panicking, and a powerful new ally emerges.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Full Arsenal: Divine Abilities, Secret Arts, and a Zhuanshui Invitation
twitter_description: The Wufeng Immortal brings Ji Ning nearly every top-tier divine ability from the Black-White College. Also, a political rival of the Shaoyan clan makes their move.

lore_anchors.definition: The ancient epoch before the current Three Realms were fully formed, when the original Fiendgods and clans like the Zhuanshui and Xiamang fought for supremacy.
The elite guards of the Grand Xia Dynasty's princes and marquises, in this context assigned by Yan Marquis to protect Ji Ning.
A cultivator who failed the Celestial Tribulation but survived as a Loose Immortal, doomed to suffer periodic tribulations until extinction.
